description: Use when the only question is whether a site is listed as dangerous, before an agent reads, cites, links to or pays it. Returns whether it is listed as malware or phishing (Google Safe Browsing, the Cloudflare security resolver, PhishTank), which list says so, where to check it and where its owner requests a review, plus HSTS preload and the hacked-site signatures from its latest CrawlCheck scan. An unread list is reported as unread, never as clean. For an allow/block decision on a specific action call preflight; for the full record call resolve_domain. Free, read-only.
name: check_site_safety
title: Site safety check
